column1: # The obligations checklist: one row per normative statement of the pinned
# Federation Tier with AQL specification (every page under
# modules/ROOT/pages and both JSON schemas), with the status FerroFED holds
# for it (#278). Tab-separated; lines starting with # are comments.
# A statement is a sentence or table cell carrying MUST, MUST NOT, SHALL,
# REQUIRED, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT or RECOMMENDED, or a MAY that obliges a
# declaration or names a capability the gateway has to decide on. A sentence
# carrying two obligations is two rows. The section 17 points themselves stay
#   id                 page stem, then the nearest anchor or section number,
#                      then an ordinal; a schema row uses its JSON pointer
#   page               the vendored file the statement is in
#   anchor_or_section  the anchor or section number the id is built from
#   actor              Gateway, Node or Operator (section 16.2), Client, or
#                      Editor (a sentence addressed to a future release)
#   n, cp              the requirement and the conformance point, or -
#   evidence           the test as file::function (a bare ::function names
#                      another in the file before it), the code, the issue
#   clause             the statement, shortened with ... where long
#   tested          a test asserts it; evidence names the test
#   built-untested  the code does it and no test asserts it; evidence names the issue
#   planned         not built yet; evidence names the open issue
#   missing         not built, found missing by this audit; evidence names the issue
#   deferred        not built by the owner's decision; evidence names where it was made
#   new-gap         a contradiction or silence of the text found by this audit;
#   contradiction   a contradiction of the text already on #212; evidence names the comment
#   node            a Node obligation, scored against the member nodes (section 16.2)
#   operator        an Operator obligation, met at admission or in the registry
#   n/a             no gateway obligation (a client's, an editor's, or a
#                   permission the gateway does not take); evidence gives the reason
# conformance/obligation-sources.tsv holds a digest of the lines carrying a
# keyword in each vendored page and schema, derived by
# or rewords such a line fails `scripts/checks/obligations.sh` until the rows
# of that page are reclassified and the digest is derived again.
